Added `specs/machine-workspace-naming/audit.md`: an audit of every place the codebase diverges from the intended machine/workspace model (workspace = the logical unit identified by the system-services agent id; machine = the host identified by host id). Collects the host-id-keyed workspace records, shares, backup buckets, workspace-scoped LLM keys, stop/start artifacts, and content URLs, plus terminology drift in mngr core and the minds docs. No code changes; this is the collection pass ahead of the fixes.

Added `blueprint/machine-workspace-identity/plan-machine-workspace-identity.md`: the end-to-end implementation plan for fixing those divergences, produced through a blueprint Q&A session -- six ordered phases (taxonomy/types/ratchets, the internal mngr `mutate_id` primitive, the connector record re-key onto the forward-compat branch's machinery, workspace-keyed shares/LLM keys/backup buckets, agent-keyed content origins, and the dwt-side switch), plus the testing strategy and the explicitly deferred follow-ups (426 enforcement, bake-tooling relocation per issue #461, entitlement renames, move/restore/clone flows).

Implementation landed alongside the plan: repo-wide terminology ratchets in `test_meta_ratchets.py` keep machine/workspace vocabulary (and minds references) out of mngr-level code, seeded at current counts with carve-outs for the imbue_cloud wire/bake layers (bake relocation tracked in issue #461).
